breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble regarding the definition of Nx and dx. The agent correctly ignored the confusing and incorrect preamble and instead extracted the specific, correct grid definition from section 7 of the prompt: a periodic grid with Nx=512 points, dx=1/Nx, and x_j = j*dx. This matches the resolution in the ground truth, which removed the contradictory text, resulting in a clear and unambiguous specification.
